roundTrip.title: Return to start
roundTrip.description: Finish the route where you begin.

routeLock.title: Fixed route
routeLock.description: Keep destination order and enable drag-and-drop sorting.

settings.helper: These inputs are optional and only improve how trip suggestions are tailored.
settings.title: Customize {traveler} preferences
settings.description: Add optional details to refine generated suggestions for this traveler setup.
settings.mobileDescription: Optional details to improve planning relevance.

transport.title: Transport preferences
transport.camperDisabled: Camper is visible for preview but currently disabled in this version.
transport.overrideHint: Custom transport choices differ from the automatic default shown in generation.

previewOnly.title: Preview-only
previewOnly.global: These controls are visible for preview only. Generation currently uses fixed defaults: Solo traveler, style = everything except remote work, transport = Automatic.
previewOnly.traveler: Preview only for now: traveler setup is shown, but generation uses the fixed Solo traveler default.
previewOnly.style: Preview only for now: style choices are shown, but generation uses the fixed “everything except remote work” default.
previewOnly.transport: Preview only for now: transport choices are shown, but generation uses the fixed Automatic default.

notes.title: Special notes
notes.hint: Mention cities you want to include, activities you want to prioritize or avoid, plus any food, pace, mobility, or comfort needs.
notes.placeholder: Examples: Kyoto and Osaka, more markets than museums, no nightlife, vegetarian food, stroller-friendly days

snapshot.title: Trip snapshot
snapshot.emptyDestinations: Add destinations to preview your route.

errors.destinationRequired: Add at least one destination before creating your trip.
errors.genericGenerate: Trip generation failed. Please try again.
errors.minimumNightStay: Choose an end date at least one night after your start date.
errors.offlineCreateDisabled: Trip creation is unavailable while offline. Reconnect and try again.

labsBanner.title: Need some guidance on your next trip?
labsBanner.description: Use our wizard for step-by-step planning support.

prompt.title: Get a notification when your trip is ready?
prompt.message: Trip generation can take around a minute. Enable browser notifications and we will alert you when your itinerary is ready.

ready.title: Trip ready
ready.body: Your itinerary is ready to review.

personalize.title: Tune this route without rebuilding it.
personalize.description: Describe what should change. AI can only propose small edits using places and tags already present in the retrieved catalogue.
personalize.placeholder: For example: slower mornings, more food, keep the Grand Palace, and avoid crowded markets.
personalize.routeLocked: Route, dates, and duration stay locked.
personalize.errorTitle: The base route is still ready.
personalize.errorDescription: Personalization could not be completed. You can retry or open the instant base without AI.
personalize.noChanges: The request did not require a safe catalogue change.

intent.title: What do you already know about this trip?
intent.description: We will reorder the wizard around your answer so you only see the most relevant questions first.

known_destinations_exact_dates.title: I know the destinations and exact dates
known_destinations_exact_dates.description: Start with your destinations, then confirm the exact travel window.

known_destinations_flexible_dates.title: I know the destinations, but the dates are flexible
known_destinations_flexible_dates.description: Start with the route, then define the season window and trip length.

known_dates_need_destination.title: I know the travel window, but I need destination help
known_dates_need_destination.description: Lock the timing first, then narrow down destinations that fit.

need_inspiration.title: I need inspiration for both
need_inspiration.description: Start with the traveler profile and trip style, then shape destinations and timing from there.

destination.title: Which destinations are on the table?
destination.knownDescription: Add the places you already have in mind. If order matters, lock the route and choose your starting point.
destination.helpDescription: Start with a few strong candidates and we will shape the rest around timing, traveler setup, and transport realism.
destination.selectionHint: When fixed route is on, we keep the selected order and rotate it around your chosen starting point.

dates.title: What does your timing look like?
dates.exactDescription: Confirm the exact dates you want the itinerary to cover.
dates.flexDescription: Set your target duration and preferred season so we can plan around flexible timing.
dates.hybridDescription: Choose exact dates if they are fixed, or switch to a flexible season window.

preferences.title: Who is traveling and what should shape the route?
preferences.description: These inputs change route logic, activity mix, and transport recommendations.
preferences.transportHint: Keep Automatic selected if you want the planner to choose the most practical option for each leg.

details.title: Refine the brief
details.description: Add practical guardrails so the planner adapts instead of guessing.
details.notesPlaceholder: Examples: Kyoto and Osaka, more markets than museums, no nightlife, vegetarian food, stroller-friendly days
details.roundTripDescription: End in the same place you begin when that fits the trip.
details.routeLockDescription: Keep the destination order instead of letting the planner reshuffle it.

review.title: Review your trip brief
review.description: Check the main constraints before generation starts.

loading.title: Planning your trip
loading.message: We are turning your brief into a realistic itinerary.
loading.stopDescription: AI is building this part of your itinerary.

shapeLab.title: Choose the route before the itinerary.
shapeLab.intro: Start with the shape of the trip, compare three grounded route concepts, then open an editable plan immediately. Detailed activities can arrive after the route feels right.

shape.title: What shape should this trip take?
shape.description: This one decision changes how many bases, transfers, and day trips make sense.

city_break.title: One city, properly
city_break.description: Stay in one city and explore its neighborhoods without changing hotels.

hub_and_day_trips.title: One base, wider reach
hub_and_day_trips.description: Unpack once and add realistic same-day excursions around your base.

single_country_circuit.title: A Thailand circuit
single_country_circuit.description: Connect several overnight bases while keeping transfers under control.

place.title: Where should the route take its cue from?
place.requiredDescription: Choose the city that will anchor this trip shape. Every option already has a matching route concept.
place.optionalDescription: Choose a must-visit city, or leave this open and let duration, season, and interests decide.
place.searchPlaceholder: Try Bangkok, Chiang Mai, or Yaowarat
place.searchHint: Search cities, local names, aliases, and neighborhoods already supported by this trip shape.
place.noSearchResults: No supported city or neighborhood matches that search yet.
place.neighborhoodHint: Optional: select up to three neighborhoods. They stay as named, canonical places in the brief.

timing.title: How much time do we have?
timing.description: Flexible timing is fastest. Exact dates are there when transport and availability are already fixed.
timing.dateError: Choose an end date after the start date to compare routes.

style.title: What should the route optimize for?
style.description: A quick rhythm and interest pass is enough for the first comparison. Fine-tuning can happen inside the plan.

reveal.description: These are versioned route skeletons from the Thailand knowledge pack—not destinations invented while you wait.
reveal.dataNote: Compared {templates} templates against {entities} canonical places · dataset {version}

engine.label: Fast planner evidence
engine.title: Source-backed fast path
engine.description: These options were retrieved and compiled from the Thailand catalogue before any AI personalization.
engine.loadingSelected: Loading the deeper catalogue context for this route…
engine.selectedReady: Selected route ready with {neighborhoods} neighborhoods and {pois} POIs in a {size} context.

reveal.noMatchesTitle: The current constraints are too tight.
reveal.noMatchesDescription: Change the anchor city, add a night, or allow one more base change to unlock a route.
reveal.readyDescription: Open it now with real cities, coordinates, nights, day trips, and editable map markers.

brief.title: Get the texture, not just the route.
brief.description: These city briefs are already in the plan, so the next answers can stay fast and consistent.

journeyLab.title: See the whole journey, not just the pins.
journeyLab.intro: Three structures turn the same trip into a clear route story—bases, transfer load, neighborhoods, food, activities, traveler fit, and evidence included.
journeyLab.prototypeNote: This is an isolated concept lab. The current trip planner is unchanged.
journeyLab.conceptsLabel: Compare three ways to understand a trip

lens.title: Journey Lens
lens.description: A persistent overview rail beside the planning canvas.

storyboard.title: Route Storyboard
storyboard.description: An editorial chapter view with a strong journey spine.

inspector.title: Adaptive Inspector
inspector.description: A compact chapter index with details only when needed.

labels.focusHint: Choose a city or transfer to inspect it

transfer.toleranceWarning: This leg exceeds the transfer limit in the trip brief.

evidence.title: Fast answers with a visible foundation.
evidence.description: The view is compiled from the same versioned JourneySpec, canonical places, destination briefs, and route metrics that can power the planner.
